prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: master illustration for Whereday App Store search creative and animated product-page header.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the project's current cream and indigo architectural pen sketch. Make a new composition in this same restrained illustration family.
Primary request: a beautifully art-directed three-panel accordion-folded paper city map, viewed from slightly above, floating on warm ivory paper. The subject is a private journal of a day wandering through San Francisco. The folded map is the single centerpiece, broad, horizontal, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the image width and 57% of height. A delicate engraved indigo sketch of Victorian homes at the left rear of the map, a small corner cafe at the upper center, a few miniature cypress trees, and a tiny Golden Gate Bridge at the right rear. Roads snake elegantly between the illustrated buildings. A pale muted blue bay is drawn on the right fold. The map has three broad concertina folds with soft physical paper ridges, believable fine paper texture and a very soft short contact shadow. Buildings are pen illustrations on and rising gently out of the folded map, like a small charming pop-up travel journal, not realistic 3D buildings. Lots of breathing room around the subject. No text or labeling.
Style: original, sophisticated fine indigo ballpoint linework, natural irregular pressure, architectural hatching, almost monochrome indigo #203557 on aged ivory #F8F5EB with a very faint muted blue watercolor bay. Delicate editorial travel sketch, crafted and quiet, highly polished composition. Wide landscape aspect ratio 3:2.
Background: plain warm ivory #F8F5EB edge to edge, empty clean upper and lower margins, no landscape outside the folded map.
Constraints: no text, no typography, no lettering, no numbers, no branding, no logos, no phones, no app screens, no navigation pins, no location markers, no red dots, no colored path, no large compass. The route and markers will be separate vector layers added later for animation. No dramatic light, no gradients, no glossy materials, no thick cartoons, no photorealism. Ensure the full map is visible, centered with all corners inside the frame.
